sources.title: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact original Instruct repository: Meta developer, multilingual text input/output, 3B (3.21B), GQA, shared embeddings, original 128k context, September 25, 2024 release and custom community license. Fresh parameter recheck confirms the published nominal 3.21B and identifies the tuned models as SFT/RLHF versions, with final chat models aligned on top of the pretrained model. The card has no separate active-parameter count.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 launch announcement
sources.evidence: September 25, 2024 announcement releases text-only 1B/3B pretrained and instruction-tuned models with 128K context and downloadable weights. It explicitly describes multilingual generation and tool calling for the lightweight models.

sources.title: Official Llama model SKU definitions
sources.evidence: Exact meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct SKU uses arch_args_3b: dimension 3072, 28 layers, 24 attention heads, 8 KV heads, vocabulary 128256. INT4 QLoRA/SpinQuant are separately named variants.

sources.title: Official model types and context limits
sources.evidence: BF16 is the default checkpoint format. The Llama 3.2 max_seq_length property returns 131072 except INT4 variants, which return 8192.

sources.title: Official Llama Transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Causal Transformer blocks execute grouped-query attention and a three-projection SiLU-gated dense feedforward network in every layer; no expert router is present.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 text prompt format
sources.evidence: Explicitly documents zero-shot function calling for Llama 3.2 1B and 3B Instruct, accepting functions in system or user messages and returning Python-style calls. Describes chat, function execution and code interpreter formats without a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode.

sources.title: Introducing quantized Llama models
sources.evidence: October 24, 2024 announcement releases QLoRA and SpinQuant variants of the previously released BF16 1B/3B models. These new variants prioritize applications up to 8K context.

sources.title: Shared Llama 3.2 model card updated for quantization
sources.evidence: Shared card reports 3B (3.21B), GQA/shared embeddings and separate original 128k versus quantized 8k rows. Its October 24, 2024 release date is the later quantized update; the exact original repository and launch announcement establish September 25. Fresh parameter recheck confirms the same nominal total and post-training lineage, with no separate active count.

sources.title: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom Llama 3.2 Community License governs model weights and permits use, modification and redistribution subject to its terms; version release date is September 25, 2024.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access check
sources.evidence: Unauthenticated request returned HTTP 401. No access-gate bypass or weight download was attempted; public Meta source code supplies architecture and exact context evidence.

sources.title: Zipf’s and Heaps’ Laws for Tokens and LLM-generated Texts, Table 3 and sections 4.1/4.4
sources.publisher: Nikolay Mikhaylovskiy, NTR Labs / Tomsk State University; EMNLP Findings 2025
sources.evidence: Table 3 (PDF page 4) explicitly reports Llama-3.2-3B at 3.21B Params and 3.21B Active params. Section 4.1 identifies the listed models as base and original instruction-finetuned models, evaluated with BitsAndBytes NF4 quantization. Section 4.4 and visually checked Figure 10 (PDF page 7) compare base L3 and instruction-tuned L3i, establishing 3B Instruct coverage. This is the original researcher’s nominal active-count convention, not a Meta disclosure or an exact per-token tensor census.

architecture.note: Dense causal Transformer classification follows Meta code: 28 layers, dimension 3072, 24 query/8 KV heads and ordinary SiLU-gated feedforward projections. The card confirms shared embeddings.

modalities.note: This is the text-only model; generated code is text, not an additional modality.

reasoning.note: Accessible card and prompt documentation do not disclose a dedicated reasoning mode. General reasoning ability and benchmark results do not prove this boolean; clear baseline false.

tool_call.note: Meta explicitly documents zero-shot custom function calling for the 3B Instruct model.

patch.notes: Original BF16 Instruct model. Meta publishes a nominal 3.21B total with shared embeddings. The 3.21B active count follows Mikhaylovskiy’s research convention (Table 3; original Instruct coverage in sections 4.1/4.4 and Figure 10), not a Meta disclosure or exact per-token tensor census. Dense Transformer with GQA. Original context is 131,072 tokens; later official INT4 variants use 8,192. September 25, 2024 is the original release; October 24 is the quantized update. Custom function calling is documented; dedicated reasoning-mode support is undisclosed.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains Meta’s published nominal 3.21B total and establishes 3.21B nominal active parameters from Mikhaylovskiy’s original research table. Visually checked Table 3 and Figure 10, plus sections 4.1/4.4, establish original 3B Instruct coverage. Searches and reopened Meta cards found no separate Meta active-count disclosure; the accepted value is the researcher’s convention, not an exact per-token census. Preserve all twelve unrelated field assessments.
